evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.

events.title: Everything I Want to Do In a Show | A One Woman Show
events.summary: Heather Sejnow presents a campy, crazy, and heartfelt one-woman show featuring puppets, impressions, burlesque, song, dance, and Shakespeare. This interactive, NSFW performance is a love letter to creativity and the people met along the way.

evidence.description: It's campy, crazy, and heartfelt. Most importantly, it's a love letter to everyone I've met and all the vessels of creativity I've learned along the way. Oh! And it's interactive, NSFW, and there will be some prizes for attendees. So come join me on a wild ride filled with puppets, impressions, burlesque, song, dance, and even Shakespeare.

events.title: Tropical precarity
events.summary: Explore the intersections of performance, visual art, gender expression, and cultural resistance in Puerto Rico through a special performance and panel discussion featuring acclaimed artists Freddie Mercado Velázquez and Mickey Negrón.

evidence.description: The Latina/o Studies and the Contemporary Performance in Puerto Rico Working Group, in partnership with the Department of American Culture, invites you to Tropical Precarity: Drag and Visual Arts in Puerto Rico, a special performance and panel discussion. This event features an in-depth conversation with acclaimed Puerto Rican artists Freddie Mercado Velázquez and Mickey Negrón, exploring the intersections of performance, visual art, gender expression, and cultural resistance.
